name: Monotonic Minimum Teaching Set Size / Minimum Teaching Set Size
proof: The monotonic variant maximizes the minimum teaching-set size over subfamilies, and the original class is among those subfamilies.
witness_verification: For C_mts = {000, 100, 010, 110, 001}, the minimum teaching-set size is 1, while the four-concept two-cube subfamily forces the monotonic variant to equal 2.
